oneTimers: Tariff refunds added approximately 1 percentage point to gross margin and $0.05 to diluted EPS in the quarter — a one-off benefit called out in the release, not recurring run-rate profit.
verdict: Apple's September quarter set records — $114.5B in revenue, iPhone up 17% to $57.6B — with Services at an all-time high and a one-off tariff refund adding a point to the margin.
footerNote: Segments are net sales by product category, as Apple reports them.
follow100Note: iPhone alone is $50.30 of every $100 Apple takes in. The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: iPhone 17 drove a record quarter
takeaways.text: iPhone revenue hit a September-quarter record $57.6B, up 17% on the iPhone 17 lineup — half of everything Apple sold.

takeaways.title: Services is the quiet giant
takeaways.text: Services set an all-time high at $31.6B, up 10% — nearly 28% of revenue, and the steadiest growth Apple has.

takeaways.title: The margin got a one-off lift
takeaways.text: Gross margin of 47.9% included about 1 point from tariff refunds, worth $0.05 of EPS — a one-off, not the run rate.
